title: Mu Research Away Conference Probe
graph_command: hud-away-probe <project> mu/research/presentation/afc/ScoreHud <AFC IDs from conference map>
limits: Native afternoon rule only; no arbitrary external network override.
AFC-away SNF priority observed; AFC-away TNF/MNF and full mixed-context return matrix remain incomplete.
Team mapping is the baseline 32-team conference map; custom, relocated and realigned teams remain unverified.

node_initialization.exported_guid: new unique GUID for each added node
node_initialization.identity_mask: unique GUID-derived 24-bit mask, excluding existing node masks
node_initialization.rebuild: --rebuild restores only the native wrapper in an offline project before regenerating its graph
